'''Ice Blitz''' requires a [[Magic]] level of 82. It is capable of hitting up to 26 damage (without any [[magic damage]] boosts) per cast.

Ice Blitz can freeze targets, rendering them unable to move for {{ticks|24}}, or {{ticks|26}} with the [[Ancient sceptre]].

As with all [[Ancient Magicks]] spells, the quest [[Desert Treasure I]] must be completed to cast this spell.

Ice Blitz is commonly utilised by [[player killers]] who intend on "[[rushing]]" another player. These type of player-killers often cast Ice Blitz, and continue on to attack their target for three hits using a [[granite maul]] (1 regular hit and 2 [[special attack]] hits). As the spell has a delay of a few seconds before hitting the player, this allows rushers to potentially land four high-damaging, near-simultaneous hits on their target.

Ice Blitz, like all Ice spells, gains a 10% accuracy bonus against unfrozen targets while wielding the [[Ice ancient sceptre]].

Ice Blitz has the same accuracy as [[Ice Barrage]] against one target.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/651058586991362048|date=5 October 2015|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/100043|archivedate=29 May 2020|quote=Nope.}}
